description: Post-ending rotating daily window visits (every 4 days) for Love, Maid, and Revolution routes.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她停在窗前，掀开食盒盖，把热汤推到你手边。
lines.en: She stops by the window, lifts the lid off the food box, and slides the hot soup over to your hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我就猜到你一翻起这堆旧账本，连午饭钟点都能忘得一干二净。
lines.en: I knew it. The moment you start flipping through those old ledgers, you forget all about lunch.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 趁热喝，我盯着火候炖了半个钟头，凉了可没这香味。
lines.en: Drink it while it's hot. I watched the pot for a good half hour — it won't smell half as good once it's cold.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 辛苦我们家夫人专门跑一趟。
lines.en: Thanks for making the trip all the way out here, my lady wife.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 少拿好听话糊弄我，跑腿送饭可不是白送的呀。
lines.en: Don't think sweet talk gets you out of this — running errands and delivering lunch isn't free, you know.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 街口安静下来，她顺势趴近窗沿，弯起眉眼用指尖勾了下你的尾指。
lines.en: The street quiets down. She leans in over the windowsill, eyes curving into crescents, and hooks her fingertip around your pinky.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚早点落锁回家……进门得先补我一个结结实实的拥抱。
lines.en: Lock up early and come home tonight... and the first thing through the door better be a proper, tight hug for me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 记下了，今晚早点打烊。
lines.en: Noted. I'll close up early tonight.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这还差不多，可不许再让我和晚饭一块儿干等你。
lines.en: That's more like it. And don't leave me and dinner waiting on you again.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她拎着商街纸袋，在窗前轻快转了半圈。
lines.en: She whirls half a turn by the window, carrying a paper bag from the shopping street.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，大忙人，把视线从账本上挪开两秒。
lines.en: Hey, busy man—lift your eyes off that ledger for two seconds.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 给你三次机会猜猜，我今天身上哪儿不一样了？
lines.en: I'll give you three guesses. What's different about me today?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 新裁的露肩裙，连发梢都梳亮了。
lines.en: A newly tailored off-shoulder dress—you even polished your hair ends.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 站在窗前太晃眼，好看得过分。
lines.en: Standing there in the window, you're blinding. Ridiculously pretty.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……算你眼光还行，没白费我绕两条街过来。
lines.en: ...So your taste isn't hopeless after all. Worth the two-street detour.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她耳尖微热，把纸袋往怀里一抱，突然俯身贴近你的窗沿。
lines.en: Her ears flush warm. She hugs the paper bag to her chest and suddenly leans in close over your windowsill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 不过嘛，这袋子里还藏着另一件更薄的小东西呢。
lines.en: But there's something else hiding in this bag—something thinner.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那种料子可不能在街上穿……只留着今晚回屋给你一个人看。
lines.en: That kind of fabric can't be worn out on the street... it's saved for tonight, back in our room, for your eyes only.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 故意来勾我的魂？
lines.en: So you came here just to tempt me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 谁让你总守着破柜台呀，早点落锁回家亲自拆，我等你。
lines.en: Well, someone has to keep guarding that beat-up counter. Lock up early and come home to unwrap it yourself—I'll be waiting.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 咳，我来替母亲带句话。
lines.en: Ahem. I'm here to pass along a message from Mother.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她嫌你昨晚收摊太晚，今晚挑了水培农场刚摘的鲜蔬炖菜。
lines.en: She's cross that you closed up so late last night, so tonight she's stewing fresh greens just picked from the hydroponic farm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 让你绝不许再误了饭点。
lines.en: And you are absolutely not to miss mealtime again.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 替我谢过咱妈，今晚一定准时。
lines.en: Tell our mom thanks for me—I'll be there right on time tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她耳根微红，指尖叩了叩窗台，忽然俯身凑近半步。
lines.en: Her ears flush faintly pink. She taps her fingertips on the windowsill, then suddenly leans in half a step closer.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 慢着，话还没传完呢。
lines.en: Hold on—the message isn't finished yet.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 准点回家吃饭是母亲叮嘱的……
lines.en: Coming home on time for dinner is Mother's instruction...

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 但把打烊时间再提前半个钟头，进门不许再翻半页账本——
lines.en: But closing up another half hour earlier, and not turning a single page of the ledger once you're through the door—

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这两条，可是我自己硬塞进去的新规矩。
lines.en: Those two? Those are new rules I wedged in myself.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 遵命，都听夫人的。
lines.en: As you command, my lady. Whatever you say.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这还差不多，少一分钟我可就在窗前盯梢了。
lines.en: That's more like it. Be even a minute late and I'll be keeping watch from the window.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她披着你宽大的旧外套趴在窗沿，长袖一直盖过半截手背。
lines.en: She leans on the windowsill in your big old coat, the sleeves hanging past half her hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 看什么呀，我可是专门来盯你准点收摊的。
lines.en: What are you looking at? I came all this way just to make sure you close up on time.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天通道里风大，顺手把你这件旧外套穿出来了，暖和得很。
lines.en: It was windy in the walkway today, so I grabbed this old coat of yours on my way out. Keeps me nice and warm.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 袖子都快盖住手了。
lines.en: The sleeves are practically swallowing your hands.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 大点才好呢……领口全是你的木头味，闻着就让人安心。
lines.en: The bigger the better... the collar smells all of your woodshop. Just breathing it in settles me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 以前隔着这扇窗，我满脑子都在算计怎么跟你压价还债。
lines.en: Back when it was just this window between us, all I could think about was how to haggle you down and pay off my debt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在倒好，每天数着钟点，最盼着听见卷帘咔哒落锁的声音。
lines.en: And now? I count the hours, and the sound I look forward to most is that shutter clicking down.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把下巴埋进厚实的衣领里，隔着衣料轻轻蹭了蹭你的手背。
lines.en: She buries her chin in the thick collar and brushes your hand softly through the fabric.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 再有两分钟就收摊。
lines.en: Two more minutes till closing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那你快点呀……今晚脚凉，到家门口就得抱我回被窝，不许偷懒。
lines.en: Then hurry it up... my feet are cold tonight, so the moment we're at the door you're carrying me straight to bed. No slacking.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 早市进的那批日用品清点完了，账单在这儿。
lines.en: I've finished tallying the daily goods from the morning market. Here's the bill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 送货的油滑贩子见我穿侍从裙，故意虚抬了两成报价。
lines.en: That slick-tongued peddler saw me in my attendant's dress and tried to pad his quote by twenty percent.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我当场挑明封口开胶，逼他乖乖按老底价结了账。
lines.en: I pointed out the seals were coming unglued, right to his face, and made him settle at the old base price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 干得漂亮，愈发像半个当家了。
lines.en: Nicely done. You're more than half a shopkeeper now.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 巷口脚步声彻底走远，她忽然倾身撑住窗沿。
lines.en: The footsteps at the mouth of the alley fade away entirely. She suddenly leans in over the windowsill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。
lines.en: ...Master.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 替店里省下这么大一笔信用点，光嘴上夸一句就想打发我呀？
lines.en: I saved the shop a good pile of credits, and you think a few kind words are enough to send me off?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 那我们功臣想要什么？
lines.en: So what does our heroine want, then?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在先记在账上……等今晚落了锁，主人再慢慢拿私房奖赏犒劳我。
lines.en: Put it on the ledger for now... Once the doors are locked tonight, Master can take his time paying me back with a little private reward.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她步子还没停稳，微喘着趴上窗台。
lines.en: Still catching her breath, she leans onto the windowsill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 刚从上层剧场排完新曲，花束都快把后台堆满了。
lines.en: Just came from rehearsing the new number up at the Upper Theater — the bouquets nearly buried the whole backstage.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 好几个体面人堵在廊下想邀我喝一杯，我连衣角都没让人碰。
lines.en: A few respectable gentlemen were blocking the corridor, angling to buy me a drink. I didn't even let them touch the hem of my dress.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 大明星还急着往旧当铺跑？
lines.en: And the big star still comes rushing back to a shabby old pawnshop?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 台上风光是做给旁人看的，我下台自然得先回你这儿报到呀。
lines.en: The glamour on stage is for other people's eyes. Once I'm off it, naturally I have to report in here first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她确认巷口无人，倾身凑近窗口，呼吸温热。
lines.en: She checks that the mouth of the alley is empty, then leans close to the window, her breath warm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……主人。那首新歌里，我私藏了一段绝不登台的副歌。
lines.en: …Master. In that new song, I've stashed away a chorus that will never see a stage.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 连乐师都没听全呢，词写得太羞人，我才不唱给别人听。
lines.en: Even the musicians haven't heard all of it. The lyrics are far too scandalous — I won't sing them for anyone else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 留着今晚唱给我一个人验收？
lines.en: So you're saving it for tonight, when I get to be the only one who judges it?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嗯，回房只留一盏暖灯，我贴在你耳边慢慢唱给你听。
lines.en: Mm. Back in our room, just one warm lamp lit — I'll press against your ear and sing it to you, nice and slow.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把采买的小包搁上窗台，扶着窗沿轻轻晃了晃脚踝。
lines.en: She sets the little shopping bag down on the windowsill and, steadying herself against the frame, gives her ankle a gentle roll.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 嘶……这双新鞋的金属搭扣太紧了，连着长袜勒得脚踝发烫。
lines.en: Hiss... the metal clasp on these new shoes is far too tight—pinching right through my stockings, and my ankle's burning.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 才走完两条街，脚后跟都磨得又酸又红。
lines.en: Two streets was all it took. My heels are rubbed raw and aching.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 先回屋换双平底鞋歇着？
lines.en: Want to go inside first and change into flats, rest a while?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在回去，还不是得我自己弯腰解扣子？那多没意思呀。
lines.en: And if I go back now, I'd still have to bend down and undo them myself, wouldn't I? Where's the fun in that?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她耳尖微红地贴近窗格，微凉的指尖轻搭上你的手背。
lines.en: Ear tips faintly flushed, she leans close to the window lattice and rests her cool fingertips lightly on the back of your hand.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 反正巷子里没人……主人，我今天可是替你跑腿才磨红了脚的。
lines.en: There's no one in the alley anyway... Master, I only wore my feet red today running errands for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚打烊回房，你肯不肯俯下身，亲手替我解开鞋扣好好揉揉？
lines.en: Tonight, after we close up and go to our room—would you be willing to bend down and undo my shoe clasps with your own hands, and rub them properly for me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 行，今晚给你揉个够。
lines.en: Deal. Tonight I'll rub them as long as you like.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 这可是你亲口应下的……要是敢敷衍我，今晚就罚你多揉半个钟头。
lines.en: You said that out loud, so it counts... If you dare skimp on me, I'll sentence you to half an hour extra tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 昏暖的灯光落在窗台，她指尖慢悠悠绕着围裙半松的系带。
lines.en: The warm dusk light spills across the windowsill as her fingertips drift lazily around the half-loosened ties of her apron.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，我刚才擦完窗台，突然想起一件事。
lines.en: Hey—I just finished wiping down the sill, and something popped into my head.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 当年那张雇佣契约早撕了，我欠你的账也早清干净了吧？
lines.en: That employment contract got torn up ages ago, and I've long since paid off every debt I owed you, haven't I?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 现在没凭没据的，你凭什么笃定我每天还会乖乖来窗口报到呀？
lines.en: So with no papers and no proof, what makes you so sure I'll keep showing up at this window like a good girl every day?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 从来不是靠契约留你。
lines.en: It was never the contract that kept you here.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是我舍不得放人。
lines.en: It's that I couldn't bear to let you go.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 绕在指间的系带滑落，她红着耳根往前倾身，鼻尖几乎蹭过窗沿。
lines.en: The tie slips loose from her fingers. Ears burning, she leans in closer, her nose almost brushing the edge of the sill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……这还差不多，算你会说话。
lines.en: ...That's more like it. I suppose you know how to talk.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 既然我的主人不肯放人，那这条围裙，今晚就留着回房再替我解吧。
lines.en: Well then—since my master won't let me go, I'll keep this apron on, and you can undo it for me back in my room tonight.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她轻敲窗沿两下，见你默契回敲，眼角一弯笑开。
lines.en: She raps twice on the windowsill, and when you knock back in sync, her eyes curve into a smile.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 头都没全抬就敲回来，算你反应快。
lines.en: Didn't even get your head all the way up before you knocked back. Sharp reflexes — I'll give you that.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 趁换班空档例行巡街，我顺道检查一下这片的防务。
lines.en: Shift change gave me a gap, so I'm doing the rounds. Figured I'd swing by and inspect the defenses in this sector.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她从胸前温热内袋摸出颗军用水果糖塞进你掌心，倾身贴近窗格。
lines.en: She fishes a military-issue fruit candy out of the warm inner pocket of her jacket and presses it into your palm, leaning in close to the window bars.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 检查防务还带捂热的糖？
lines.en: Inspecting the defenses — with a pre-warmed candy?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 笑什么呀，配给站刚发的，揣兜里正好捂热了嘛。
lines.en: What's that laugh for? The ration station just handed them out. They warmed up nicely in my pocket, that's all.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……行啦，不拿巡街当幌子骗你了。
lines.en: …All right, fine. No more using patrol duty as my cover story.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 全站上下那么多巡逻点，只有这两下敲响是专门叫你抬头看我。
lines.en: There are patrol points all over this station, but these two knocks are the only ones that exist just to make you look up at me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 全站也只有你听得懂，这两下是在想你。
lines.en: And you're the only one in the whole station who understands — these two knocks mean I'm thinking about you.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 糖很甜，下班早点过来。
lines.en: The candy's sweet. Come by early after your shift.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她把腰间沉甸甸的武装带松开一格，额头懒洋洋抵上微凉的窗框。
lines.en: She loosens the heavy duty belt at her waist by a notch and lets her forehead rest lazily against the cool window frame.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 可算逃出来了……操练场的哨声吵得我太阳穴直跳。
lines.en: Finally, a clean escape... Those drill-yard whistles had my temples throbbing.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 两摞防务简报全被我甩给副手了，谁爱审谁审去。
lines.en: I dumped both stacks of defense briefs on my deputy. Whoever wants to review them can.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还是你这扇窗前好，刚站过来，紧绷了一上午的筋骨就全散了。
lines.en: It's better here at your window. I'd barely been standing here a moment before all the tension knotted up in me from the morning melted away.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 威风凛凛的长官也学会翘班了？
lines.en: So the fearsome commander has learned to play hooky too?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 在你面前装什么长官呀，腰都被这武装带勒酸了。
lines.en: What commander? Not in front of you. This belt's been digging into my waist all day.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 等今晚换了班，我把厚大衣扔营房，单穿里面那件黑打底过来。
lines.en: Once the shift changes tonight, I'll ditch the heavy coat in the barracks and come over in just that black undershirt.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 贴身轻便，省得你待会儿又嫌扣子多……记得留门，不许先睡。
lines.en: Snug and light—saves you from complaining about all the buttons later... Leave the door unlocked, and don't fall asleep on me.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 好，热着茶等你。
lines.en: Alright. I'll keep the tea warm and wait for you.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 顺路过来歇口气，今天巡防那片街区还算太平。
lines.en: I was passing by, thought I'd catch my breath. That patrol district was quiet enough today.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她说话时指尖微蜷，不动声色地把袖口往下扯了半寸。
lines.en: As she speaks, her fingertips curl slightly, and she casually tugs her cuff down half an inch.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 手伸出来，药棉拿好了。
lines.en: Hand out. Got the cotton swab ready.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: ……你这双眼睛到底是用来看货还是专盯我的呀？
lines.en: …Are those eyes of yours for appraising merchandise, or just for staring at me?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就搬物资时蹭破点皮，在队里连伤口都算不上呢。
lines.en: It's just a scrape from hauling supplies. Back with the squad, it wouldn't even count as a wound.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 在我这儿算，别乱动。
lines.en: It counts here. Hold still.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 她耳尖微热地乖乖摊平手背，趁药水擦过时反勾住你的尾指。
lines.en: Her ears go warm as she obediently lays her hand flat, then hooks her pinky around yours while the antiseptic passes over.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 轻点嘛……也就只有在你这扇窗前，我才这么听话。
lines.en: Easy now… Only in front of your window am I ever this well-behaved.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 放心吧，知道有人拿药棉在这儿等着查岗。
lines.en: Relax, I know someone's waiting here with a cotton swab, ready to inspect me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 往后每次出任务，我都记着全须全尾、准点回来向你报到。
lines.en: From now on, every mission, I'll remember to come back in one piece, right on time, and report to you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 银色机车钥匙在她食指尖转着圈，金属环扣在窗沿磕出脆响。
lines.en: The silver motorcycle key spins in circles on her fingertip, the metal ring clicking sharp against the windowsill.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 喂，算算日子，你有多久没听过重机车的引擎声了？
lines.en: Hey—count the days. How long has it been since you heard a heavy bike's engine roar?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我把整晚的轮休假都空出来了，车就停在巷口。
lines.en: I cleared my whole night's rotation leave. Bike's parked at the mouth of the alley.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 那件亮紫皮衣还有你的备用头盔，全给你备在车座上了。
lines.en: That bright purple leather jacket and your spare helmet—all laid out for you on the seat.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 今晚过弯还压那么低？
lines.en: Still leaning that low through the corners tonight?

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 怕啦？某人站在柜台后面倒是沉得住气。
lines.en: Scared? Says the one who stands behind the counter looking so calm and collected.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 结果每次一上后座，两条手臂恨不得嵌进我腰里。
lines.en: And yet every time you climb on the back, those arms of yours practically try to weld themselves into my waist.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 抓那么紧，连你贴着我后背的呼吸都发烫呢。
lines.en: Holding on that tight—even your breath against my back feels scorching.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 是你油门拧太狠。
lines.en: It's because you twist the throttle too hard.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今晚只会更狠。给你十分钟落卷帘，去把隧道的风全抢回来！
lines.en: Tonight it'll be even harder. You've got ten minutes to pull the shutter down—let's go steal back all the wind in that tunnel!
